info.title: OSDC Earth Cartographic Projection API
info.description: Immutable EPSG and custom projected-CRS definitions with stateless, atomic SI forward and inverse projection.

bounds.description: Approximate geographic extent in SI radians, longitude east of Greenwich; not in a non-Greenwich source CRS. West greater than east denotes antimeridian crossing.

constraints: West may exceed east for an antimeridian-crossing extent. Longitude boundaries are not always numeric lower and upper bounds.
A code alone is not globally unique. A provider UUID is not an authority code.
A matching status is not the semantic curation status. Source authority does not imply local executability.

matchScore.description: Unitless search ranking score; not a probability, confidence or scientific accuracy.
Unitless search ranking score; not a probability, confidence or scientific accuracy.

order.description: One-based official axis serialization ordinal; no physical unit.

direction.description: Official axis direction. Other includes meridian-qualified polar axes; retain authority CRS identity for exact orientation.

unitToMetre.description: Metres per one original axis unit. Source unit is Unit; target is SI metre. This coefficient is not a projection scale factor.

constraints: UnitToMetre denotes metres per explicitly identified source unit; it is not a projection scale factor.

order.description: One-based official axis serialization ordinal; no physical unit.

direction.description: Official axis direction. Other includes meridian-qualified polar axes; retain authority CRS identity for exact orientation.

baseGeographicCrs.description: Base geographic CRS and datum/prime-meridian context; forward and inverse projection retain this datum.

constraints: A datum identifier alone is not a complete CRS definition.

methodId.description: Internal UUID of the projection method, not an EPSG numeric code.

conversionName.description: Name of the configured same-datum coordinate conversion.

constraints: The underlying datum or reference frame is retained.
Catalogue availability does not imply that an operation can execute in a particular runtime.

positionIndex.description: Zero-based position in the submitted ordered batch; no physical unit.

geographicCoordinate.description: Horizontal latitude/longitude pair in SI radians on the unchanged base datum. Input/output role depends on projection direction.

constraints: No vertical coordinate is implied.

projectedCoordinate.description: Horizontal canonical easting/northing pair in SI metres. Input/output role depends on projection direction.

constraints: No height or depth coordinate is implied.
x-osdc-semantic.referenceDefinition: Canonical grid easting then northing, positive grid east/north and in SI metres, independent of authority serialization and units. Must be enforced before annotation.

gridConvergence.description: Angle in SI radians, clockwise from true/geodetic north to grid north. Null means unavailable. Numerical differentiation does not imply catalogue display precision is accuracy.

constraints: Unavailable is represented separately from zero.
Display precision does not establish convergence calculation accuracy.
x-osdc-semantic.referenceDefinition: Positive clockwise from true/geodetic north to grid north at the evaluated position. Null represents unavailable, not zero.

constraints: No vertical coordinate is implied.

geographicCoordinateReferenceSystem.description: Geographic CRS of the latitude/longitude values; longitude is relative to its prime meridian.

constraints: A datum identifier alone is not a complete CRS definition.

projectedCoordinateReferenceSystem.description: Projected CRS of the canonical SI easting/northing values.

constraints: A datum identifier alone is not a complete CRS definition.

apiAxisConvention.description: Canonical grid easting/northing in SI metres. Official CRS axis metadata remains separately available.

expectedModifiedUtc.description: Opaque pinned EarthGeodesy revision token. Copy exactly from the latest read; do not truncate or normalize.

x-osdc-semantic.referenceDefinition: UTC time-scale reference for a timestamp. Accepted serialization and representable precision are provider concerns.

constraints: An ellipsoid alone does not specify a reference frame.

constraints: Positions are not additive extents.
